service.description: The scope Home's projections share: an organization of the caller's marketing scope, or none for each of them.

Home's MarketingCards for the organization named or each of the caller's: one card per source (running campaigns, pending approvals, sends due, failed or uncertain deliveries, registrations against capacity, audience changes), each with its cardKey, title, state (available with its value and linkPath; notAvailable until its phase builds its records, never zero; failed when it could not be read) and message; failedSources names each that failed, the others still answered. Refuses a caller who reads nothing of Marketing (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

Home's Upcoming: the planned activity of the organization named or each of the caller's (campaign windows, scheduled sends, events, publication dates), rows of kind, title, date, zone, state, owner and linkPath merged by date, and each source's state (notAvailable until its phase, failed when it could not be read; failedSources names those). Refuses as get#Home.

Home's Attention: the exceptions to resolve, rows of sourceKey, recordKind, record, reason, age, action and its place as a route key (route); P1's source is the campaigns, lists and segments awaiting adoption, a Marketing administrator's (MARKETING_CONFIGURE), counted by kind; approvals (P2) and deliveries (P9) are notAvailable until built. Each source's state as get#Upcoming. Refuses as get#Home.

The SettingsIndex: the Marketing settings built so far, each with entryKey, title, description, category, owner, its place as a route key (route) and its readiness text; P1 the adoption of unowned records. Refuses a caller without MARKETING_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED).

Marketing's setup readiness, answering the framework's readiness contract (moqui.server.ReadinessProvider marketing.setup) with no adapter: called with providerKey and an organizationPartyId of the caller's scope (or none), returns checks of checkKey, title, state (ready, warning, failed or unavailable), reasonCode, message, subject and scope, and for a check that is not ready its place as a route key (fixRoute): P1 the campaigns, lists and segments that belong to no organization and await adoption (marketingAdoption), which are no organization's and so checked once. Later phases add theirs. One check that fails is unavailable by name and the others go on. Changes nothing. Refuses a caller without MARKETING_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside their scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).
